events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez. Born March 14th, 1968. I need a refill of my thyroid tablets .
One moment while I check your details.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, levothyroxine fifty microgram tablets, one tablet every morning, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Right, I'll send that request for review.
Your request reference is R Q, two six one nine. It is awaiting prescribing team review.
